items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I was 100 percent influenced, Tom, by my brother

ctx.x: We are on. We're rolling. This is April, 1975, talking with Horace Henderson in Denver, Colorado. Horace, actually, I'd like to get a little bit of biographical material. We have a certain amount that is available to us, but I think that one thing particularly interests me and all of us is basically, what got you involved in music and how old were you and what were you doing when you really first started in music?

Well, naturally, the number one thing -- I was 100 percent influenced, Tom, by my brother, you know, and even before I could play a note, he was playing, and he was going to school at that time in Atlanta University which wasn't too far from home. And he would come home about twice a month, I guess, and he'd play the piano, which we still have in Georgia, with my sister, and he would just sit down and play, and we would have selections to call, and he would just play anything -- anything that we asked for. We…
Um-huh. Had he taken lessons prior to going to college?
